cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, has the whole congregation of Israel on the move. They leave the Desert of Sin, moving from place to place as the LORD commanded, and they set up camp at Rephidim. Nice spot, baker, with just ONE little problem.

cards.question: The whole congregation of Israel just camped at Rephidim. What's missing there?

answers.text: Water for the people to drink

cards.text: So the people come straight at Moses: “Give us water to drink.” That's not a question, friend, that's a customer slamming both hands on the counter at closing time.

cards.question: Moses asks the people why they contend with him. Then he asks why they test someone else. Who is it?

cards.text: But the people thirst for water there. And they grumble against Moses.

cards.question: The thirsty people ask Moses if he brought them out of Egypt to make them and their children and livestock die of thirst.
The whole camp is grumbling at Moses, and they're thirsty. What does Moses do?

cards.text: Moses asks the LORD what he should do with these people, and says a little more and they'll stone him. I think he's scared, friend.
The LORD answers. Moses is to walk on ahead of the people and take some of the elders of Israel with him.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses to bring something along in his hand. What is it?

answers.text: The staff he struck the Nile with
The jar of manna from the camp
A horn filled with anointing oil

cards.text: Then the LORD says, “Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb.” Water for a whole thirsty camp. Out of a ROCK, friend. A ROCK!

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses that when he ___ the rock at Horeb, water will come out of it for the people to drink.
Moses strikes the rock at Horeb where nobody else can see him.

cards.text: Then Moses gives that place not one name but TWO: Massah and Meribah.

cards.question: One reason Moses names the place Massah and Meribah is that the Israelites ___.

cards.text: They tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us or not?” Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer wondering if anybody remembered me, so I'm not pointing my mustache at anybody.
After this, the Amalekites, a people who lived in the Negev (Numbers 13:29), come and attack the Israelites at Rephidim. First no water, and now this.

cards.question: Moses tells one man to choose some men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Who does he tell?

cards.text: Joshua, Moses' assistant (Exodus 33:11), gets the fighting. But Moses has his own spot picked out for tomorrow.

cards.question: While Joshua fights the Amalekites, Moses says he'll stand on the ___ with the staff of God in his hand.

cards.text: Joshua does as Moses instructed and fights the Amalekites. Up to the top of the hill go Moses, his brother Aaron, and a man named Hur.

cards.question: Moses is up on the hilltop during the battle with Amalek. As long as Moses does what, Israel prevails?

cards.text: When he lowers them, Amalek prevails. Everything's riding on two arms, friend.
But arms get tired, and Moses' hands grow heavy. You ever hold your phone up for a group photo so long your whole arm starts SHAKING?

cards.question: Moses' hands are getting heavy up on the hill. What do Aaron and Hur do?

answers.text: Set a stone under him and hold his hands up
Take the staff and hold it up themselves
Run down the hill to help Joshua fight

cards.question: Aaron and Hur hold up Moses' hands, one on each ___, so his hands stay steady until the ___ goes down.

cards.text: So Joshua overwhelms Amalek and his army with the sword.
Then the LORD gives Moses something to write on a scroll, and tells him to recite it to Joshua.

cards.question: After the battle, the LORD tells Moses to write something on a scroll as a ___ and recite it to Joshua.
The LORD gives Moses a reason for the scroll. What does the LORD say He will do to Amalek?

answers.text: Drive them far into the east

cards.text: Then Moses builds an altar. And for the second time in this chapter, the man gets to name something.

cards.question: After the battle with Amalek, what does Moses name the altar he builds?

cards.text: Moses says, “…a hand was lifted up toward the throne of the LORD.” And he's not done talking about Amalek.

cards.question: Moses says the LORD will war against Amalek for just one generation.
